The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

jobs_results.title: Sr. Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Sr. Data Analyst – D2C Team
Location: Noida, Sector 136
Experience: 3–4 Years
Department: D2C
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
We are looking for a Sr. Data Analyst to join our D2C team and turn data into actionable business insights. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, identifying trends, building dashboards, and partnering with marketing, e-commerce, and business teams to drive better decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse sales, inventory, SKU, channel and location-level data to identify gaps and growth opportunities.
Identify inventory availability issues, stock-outs, excess inventory, ageing inventory and lost sales opportunities.
Analyse sales performance against targets, projections and historical trends.
Build and maintain MIS, dashboards and automated reporting for business and management teams.
Create clear data visibility across marketplaces and Quick Commerce channels.
Develop performance dashboards covering GMV, orders, ASP, fill rate, inventory, availability, sales contribution, growth and other key KPIs.
Work with eCommerce/operations teams to identify root causes behind sales and inventory gaps.
Develop automated reports using advanced Excel/Google Sheets formulas and SQL.
Extract and analyse large datasets using SQL and create meaningful business insights.
Track SKU-level performance and identify top/bottom performers, assortment gaps and channel-specific opportunities.
Support forecasting, projections and business planning with data-backed insights.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and timely reporting across all business
Requirements
3–4 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, E-commerce Analytics, or a similar role.
Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar BI tools.
Strong understanding of D2C/e-commerce and digital marketing metrics.
Experience working with platforms such as Google Analytics, Shopify, Amazon, Meta Ads, Google Ads, or similar tools is a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex data into simple, actionable business insights.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
What We're Looking For
Someone who doesn't just report the numbers but understands the story behind them — someone who can spot what is working, what isn't, and what the business should do next.
Why Join Us?
You’ll work closely with a fast-moving D2C team where data directly influences business, marketing, and growth decisions. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity to take ownership, experiment, and make a measurable impact.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst | Government Project
jobs_results.description:
Role & responsibilities The Data Analyst(s) shall provide dedicated, in-situ data analytics support to the Directorate for analysis of policy, operational, claims, transaction and customer service data and for generation of actionable management insights. The scope shall include, but not be limited to, the following:


Data Requirement and Data Extraction



Translate business and management requirements into structured data requirements, including relevant data fields, dimensions, measures, filters and reporting frequency.
Coordinate with CEPT and concerned technical/data teams for obtaining the required authorized Projects data.
Undertake data querying/extraction and prepare datasets required for recurring and adhoc analysis.

Data Preparation, Validation and Quality Checks

Clean, structure and validate datasets before analysis.
Undertake data-quality checks to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent or anomalous records.
Identify and communicate data-quality issues affecting the reliability or interpretation of analytical outputs.

Management Reporting and Dashboarding

Prepare periodic management reports and scorecards for parameters identified by the Directorate.
Develop dashboards and visualisations for monitoring key business and risk indicators.
Prepare concise PowerPoint presentations and management briefs highlighting significant trends, exceptions, concentrations and areas requiring attention.

Policy and Business Analytics

Analyze policy issuance/new business trends and relevant policy characteristics.
Analyze premium payment behavior, lapsation, revival and persistency.
Analyze surrender and other relevant policy/transaction patterns.
Analyze agent performance and identify significant trends, concentrations and exceptions.

Claims and Early Death Claims Analytics

Analyze claim pendency and claim settlement timelines.
Identify concentration of death and early-death claims at Circle, Region, Division, CPC/HO and other appropriate levels.
Identify unusual patterns or clusters requiring closer examination.
Analyze available data relating to reasons for claim pendency and delays.

Risk Intelligence and Early-Warning Indicators

Develop data-based indicators for identifying policies/transactions requiring closer examination.
Identify unusual combinations or concentrations involving policy issuance, early death claims, lapsation, surrender, premium payment, policy relaxations and other relevant indicators.
Develop early-warning indicators for preventive monitoring.
Prepare risk/exception reports at Circle and other appropriate levels.
Undertake analysis of policy characteristics and transaction patterns that may provide inputs for risk management and prevention/detection of possible mis-selling.

Customer Grievance Analytics

Analyze public complaints to identify recurring or systemic issues.
Identify geographical concentration and policy/service-related causes of complaints.
Provide data-based inputs for improving customer service and reducing avoidable complaints.

Field-Level Analytical Support

Provide actionable analytical inputs to Circles/Regions/Divisions/CPCs/Head Offices for corrective and preventive action.
Identify areas requiring focused review, verification or investigation based on data patterns.
Prepare focused analytical briefs/exception reports as required by the Directorate.

Ad-hoc Analytics and Management Support

Provide end-to-end analytics support on priority requests, including data querying, analysis, insight generation and presentation.
Undertake deep-dive analysis on any Project's parameter or business issue identified by the Directorate.
Undertake any other related data analytics assignment entrusted by the designated authority.

Analytics Capability and Knowledge Transfer

Develop repeatable analytical processes, reporting templates and reusable queries/models wherever practicable.
Support training and knowledge transfer to designated Project personnel to strengthen internal data analytics capability.

Key Analytical Outputs/Deliverables:

Monthly management scorecard covering relevant Project parameters, including agent activation, early death claims, lapsation & persistency and other parameters specified by the Directorate.
Periodic deep-dive reports on claims, early death claims, policy issuance, premium payment, lapsation/revival, persistency, surrender and other priority areas.
Circle-wise/appropriate-level risk and exception reports.
Early-warning indicators and data-based exception indicators.
Claims pendency and settlement-timeline analysis.
Customer grievance trend and concentration analysis.
Dashboards, visualizations and management presentations.
Data-quality and validation observations relating to datasets used for analysis.
Action-oriented analytical briefs for management and field formations.
Reusable analytical templates/processes and knowledge-transfer material.

Desired Qualification and Skill Set:

The Data Analyst should possess the following qualification, experience and technical/functional skills:
Graduate/Post-Graduate qualification in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, Business Analytics, Engineering, Management or a related discipline.

Relevant Experience

Relevant professional experience in data analytics, business analytics, MIS/management reporting, risk analytics or a related field, preferably involving large operational datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including modelling, pivot tables, dashboards, lookups, data validation and analytical functions.
Strong proficiency in PowerPoint for preparation of concise management presentations and communication of analytical findings.
Working knowledge of SQL for querying and extracting data from underlying source tables/databases.
Working knowledge of ETL concepts/tools and data-quality validation processes.
Working knowledge of dashboarding and business-intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Knowledge/proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis, data manipulation and analytical modelling is desirable.
Ability to perform trend analysis, exception analysis, concentration analysis, segmentation/clustering and other appropriate analytical technique
Ability to understand business requirements, interpret insurance/operational metrics and convert data into clear, actionable insights.
Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams and data owners, including CEPT.
Understanding of data confidentiality, access controls and secure handling of policyholder, claimant, agent and operational data.

Indicative Areas of PLI/RPLI Data Analytics
New business and policy issuancePremium payment and transaction behaviourLapsation, revival and persistencySurrenderDeath claims and early death claimsClaim pendency and settlement timelinesAgent activation and performancePolicy characteristics and transaction patternsPolicy relaxations and other relevant indicatorsCustomer grievances/complaintsCircle/Region/Division/CPC/HO-wise trends and concentrationsRisk, exception and early-warning indicators.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Join us as a Data & Analytics Analyst


This is an opportunity to take on a purpose-led role in a cutting edge Data & Analytics teamYou’ll be consulting with our stakeholders to understand their needs and identify suitable data and analytics solutions to meet them along with business challenges in line with our purposeYou’ll bring advanced analytics to life through visualisation in a meaningful way for key stakeholders, giving you excellent recognition for your workWe're offering this role at associate level
What you'll do
As a Data & Analytics Analyst, you’ll be using advanced analytics to develop business solutions which increase the understanding of our business, including its customers, processes, channels and products. You’ll be working closely with business stakeholders to define detailed business questions, problems or opportunities which can be supported through advanced analytics, making sure that new and existing processes are designed to be efficient, simple and automated where possible.


As well as this, you’ll be:


Working in an Agile way within multi-disciplinary data and analytics teams, co-ordinating resources from across the team and the business to achieve agreed project and scrum outcomesDelivering data and analytics expertise and solutions, which brings commercial and customer value to business challengesCommunicating data and analytics opportunities and bringing them to life in a way that business stakeholders can understand and engage with, supporting them to select the best approach for the business needsUsing new tools, technologies and methodologies to carry out advanced analyticsSharing relevant updates with key stakeholders bringing together advanced analytics, data science and data engineering work that is easily understandable and links back clearly to our business needs
The skills you'll need
We’re looking for someone with a passion for data and analytics together with knowledge of data architecture, key tooling and relevant coding languages. Along with proficiency in advanced analytics, you’ll bring an ability to simplify data into clear data visualisations and compelling insight using appropriate systems and tooling​. You’ll also have good financial services knowledge, and the ability to identify wider business impact, risk and opportunities, making connections across key outputs and processes.


You’ll also demonstrate:


Working knowledge/capability of cloud environment with 4+ yearsTechnical capability is a MUSTAI knowledge/capability is GOOD to haveInnovative mindset and desire to own and deliver impact for customers and colleagues

jobs_results.title: Marketing Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Marketing Data Analyst
Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai


About Us
The House of Abhinandan Lodha (HoABL), founded in 2020 by Abhinandan Lodha and headquartered in Mumbai, is a new-generation real estate and land development company transforming land ownership in India. By combining traditional land development with modern, tech-enabled processes, HoABL brings transparency, ease, and efficiency to land acquisition and investment.


The company specializes in plotted land development, creating residential and mixed-use communities including villas and township-style projects making secure and accessible land investment possible for a wider audience.


About the Role
We are seeking a Marketing Data Analyst to support data-driven marketing and growth initiatives. This role requires strong analytical reasoning, marketing logic, and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.


The ideal candidate is plug-and-play, with hands-on exposure to marketing analytics, campaign performance evaluation, attribution logic, and consumer journey analysis. You will work closely with marketing, sales, and product teams to optimize campaign performance, improve ROI, and influence strategic decisions.


Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple marketing channels (digital ads, CRM, web analytics, and internal systems).
Track and evaluate marketing KPIs to assess campaign success, efficiency, and ROI.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports for campaign performance, funnel metrics, and customer behavior.
Diagnose campaign performance issues and identify optimization opportunities using data.
Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for marketing and business teams.
Support attribution analysis and consumer journey mapping across touchpoints.
Collaborate with marketing, sales, and product stakeholders to align insights with business objectives.
Ensure data accuracy, hygiene, and adherence to internal standards.
Stay current with marketing analytics tools, platforms, and industry best practices.

Skills & Competencies Required
Core Competencies



Strong analytical and logical reasoning
Marketing logic and strategic thinking
Ability to extract value from data and influence business outcomes
Independent execution with minimal ramp-up

Marketing & Analytics Expertise

Understanding of advertising types and marketing channels
Hands-on exposure to marketing analytics and performance diagnostics
Strong knowledge of marketing KPIs and campaign success metrics
Experience with attribution models and attribution logic
Consumer journey and funnel analysis

Technical Skills

Experience with tools such as GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM platforms
Proficiency in SQL, Python, R, or advanced Excel
Experience with visualization tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Google Data Studio
Ability to work with large datasets and deliver insights under tight timelines

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related fields (B.Tech preferred)
2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, preferably in a marketing or consumer-focused environment
Demonstrated experience generating insights that drive measurable business or campaign outcomesRole & responsibilities
